```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(here)

sa_source <- st_read(here("output_data", "Australian_Aqua_sites",
                          "SA_land_sites_with_species.shp"))

combined  <- st_read(here("output_data", "summaries",
                          "AU_aquaculture_combined.gpkg"))

# Check the status column name/values first
sa_source |> st_drop_geometry() |> count(status)   # adjust col name if different

# CRS match
if (st_crs(sa_source) != st_crs(combined)) {
  sa_source <- st_transform(sa_source, st_crs(combined))
}

# Keep only SA-active source sites
sa_active <- sa_source |>
  filter(tolower(trimws(status)) == "active")

# Flag whether each active site intersects anything in combined
sa_active$detected <- lengths(st_intersects(sa_active, combined)) > 0

# Summary
sa_active |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  summarise(n_active   = n(),
            n_detected = sum(detected),
            pct        = mean(detected) * 100)


```
```{r}
combined_sa_land <- combined |> filter(state == "SA", sector == "land")
sa_active$detected <- lengths(st_intersects(sa_active, combined_sa_land)) > 0

sa_active |> filter(!detected) |> mapview::mapview()

sa_source$detected <- lengths(st_intersects(sa_source, combined_sa_land)) > 0

sa_source |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  count(status, detected) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = detected, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)
```


```{r}
sa_source$detected <- lengths(st_intersects(sa_source, combined_sa_land)) > 0

sa_source |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  count(status, detected) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = detected,
                     values_from = n,
                     values_fill = 0,
                     names_prefix = "detected_")
```

#chcek if NSW also has status
```{r}
library(sf)
library(here)
library(dplyr)

nsw <- st_read(here("raw_data", "NSW", "NSW_aquaculture_leases_2025",
                    "Aquaculture_Leases.shp"))

# 1. What columns are in the attribute table?
names(nsw)
glimpse(nsw)

# 2. Flag any columns whose NAME suggests status
status_like <- names(nsw)[grepl("status|active|current|expir|valid|state|stage|lease_typ|type",
                                 names(nsw), ignore.case = TRUE)]
status_like

# 3. For each flagged column, show unique values + counts
for (col in status_like) {
  cat("\n---", col, "---\n")
  print(table(nsw[[col]], useNA = "ifany"))
}

# 4. Fallback: if no column name looks like status, scan ALL character columns
#    for values like "active", "inactive", "current", "expired"
char_cols <- names(nsw)[sapply(st_drop_geometry(nsw), is.character)]
for (col in char_cols) {
  vals <- unique(nsw[[col]])
  hits <- vals[grepl("active|inactive|current|expir|valid|cancel|surrender",
                     vals, ignore.case = TRUE)]
  if (length(hits)) {
    cat("\nColumn", col, "contains:", paste(hits, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  }
}
```
```{r}
# Full breakdown of the column
table(nsw$DB_Lease_I, useNA = "ifany")

# Also sanity check — is this column really status, or is it an ID
# that just happens to contain the word "Current"?
head(nsw$DB_Lease_I, 20)
n_distinct(nsw$DB_Lease_I)

```

```{r}
nsw %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  count(DB_Lease_I) %>% 
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1))

```
```{r}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(here)

nsw <- st_read(here("raw_data", "NSW", "NSW_aquaculture_leases_2025",
                    "Aquaculture_Leases.shp"))

# Make sure we have a projected CRS for area calcs (GDA2020 / MGA zone 56 works for NSW)
nsw_proj <- st_transform(nsw, 7856)

# 1. Feature counts + total area by status
nsw_proj %>%
  mutate(area_ha = as.numeric(st_area(.)) / 10000) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(DB_Lease_I) %>%
  summarise(n_features = n(),
            total_area_ha = round(sum(area_ha), 1),
            mean_area_ha  = round(mean(area_ha), 2),
            median_area_ha = round(median(area_ha), 2),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(pct_area = round(100 * total_area_ha / sum(total_area_ha), 1))
```
```{r}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(here)

# Load combined national dataset
combined <- st_read(here("output_data", "summaries", 
                          "AU_aquaculture_combined.gpkg"))

# Quick peek — confirm the state column name and any status-like columns
names(combined)
glimpse(combined)

# Subset to NSW (adjust the column name if it's not `state`)
nsw_in_combined <- combined %>% filter(state == "NSW")   # or State / STATE / jurisdiction

cat("Features in raw NSW shapefile:     ", nrow(nsw), "\n")
cat("  of which Current:                ", sum(nsw$DB_Lease_I == "Current"), "\n")
cat("  of which Historic:               ", sum(nsw$DB_Lease_I == "Historic"), "\n")
cat("  of which Available POAA:         ", sum(nsw$DB_Lease_I == "Available POAA"), "\n")
cat("Features in AU_aquaculture_combined for NSW:", nrow(nsw_in_combined), "\n")
```
```{r}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(here)

# Reproject raw NSW to match combined's CRS
nsw_proj <- st_transform(nsw, st_crs(combined))
nsw_in_combined <- combined %>% filter(state == "NSW")

# Spatial join — pull DB_Lease_I onto each combined feature
check_sp <- st_join(nsw_in_combined,
                    nsw_proj %>% select(DB_Lease_I),
                    join = st_intersects,
                    largest = TRUE)

# Cross-tab: your active flag vs NSW's raw status
# (swap `active` for whatever you called the column — could be status, lease_status, etc.)
names(nsw_in_combined)   # confirm the column name first
table(check_sp$active, check_sp$DB_Lease_I, useNA = "ifany")

```
```{r}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)

nsw_proj <- st_transform(nsw, st_crs(combined))
nsw_in_combined <- combined %>% filter(state == "NSW")

check_sp <- st_join(nsw_in_combined,
                    nsw_proj %>% select(DB_Lease_I),
                    join = st_intersects,
                    largest = TRUE)

check_sp %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(DB_Lease_I) %>%
  summarise(
    n_leases              = n(),
    n_with_infra          = sum(infra_area_km2 > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_with_infra        = round(100 * mean(infra_area_km2 > 0, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    total_infra_area_km2  = round(sum(infra_area_km2, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    median_infra_km2      = round(median(infra_area_km2[infra_area_km2 > 0], na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

```
```{r}
check_sp %>% 
  filter(is.na(DB_Lease_I)) %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  select(site_id, custodian_id, infra_area_km2, status) %>%
  head(20)
```

```{r}
poaa_detected <- check_sp %>% filter(DB_Lease_I == "Available POAA", status == "active")
current_leases <- check_sp %>% filter(DB_Lease_I == "Current")

# Distance from each detected POAA to nearest Current lease
poaa_detected$dist_to_current <- st_distance(poaa_detected, current_leases) %>% 
  apply(1, min) %>% 
  as.numeric()

summary(poaa_detected$dist_to_current)
```
```{r}
# Do status and infra_area agree?
nsw_in_combined %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(has_infra = infra_area_km2 > 0) %>%
  count(status, has_infra)

```
```{r}
# Where your detection says active, what does NSW say?
check_sp %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  filter(status == "active") %>% 
  count(DB_Lease_I)
```
